sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य रक्षसा विकृतं च तत् ।पुनः प्रोवाच राजानं वसिष्ठः पुरुषर्षभम् ।। ७.६५.३४ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā pārthivendrasya rakṣasā vikṛtaṁ ca tat ।punaḥ provāca rājānaṁ vasiṣṭhaḥ puruṣarṣabham ।। 7.65.34 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that the king of kings was transformed by the Rakshasa, Vasistha again spoke to the king, who was the best among men.
